author: K_The_Sorcerer
body:
Sabbash has a video on YouTube you'll find useful.


For now, with the last week of all the Judges, go and get the highest gear you can from them... Any of the Charon Judges fit the bill. It'll be what you want or at least very good until later.

There's also gear that drops from mimics and in the arena.

The general pattern is that the Charon staves improve your summons, complete the questline for the Omegarift stone accessory which is great, the headpieces improve your pact spells, chest pieces improve the chance your summons defend you, boots improve your summons' strength.

The dungeon bosses drop your best weapon/offhand. The kingdom raids and WRB drop your best armor.

Amity with positive buff duration increase is best because you need DC to do really great damage, and you want that to stay as long as possible. Applies to Mag+++ from lugus gauntlet as well.

Good luck!


General process for fighting:

Golem's, Ward, Barrier 2, summon extra summons, mag +, mag ++,  berserk shroom, deific channel

Then start ripping damage with Blood Pact. If your summons get too low on health, use life pact a few times and then Drain or use potions to restore your own life. Use deific channel and start blood pacting again.



Throwing a couple Ashen Ruby on your weapon helps a lot with your health being drain from berserk. Soul of Charon to make your summons stronger for the rest of your adornments. You can also consider a few Heretic's Jewels.


Honorable mention for your 2nd staff: Arisen Imagination from the mimics. It's natural buffs are very nice.


Alternate way to go about it, instead of blood pact, use Rhada Pact. Any of the temporary buffs (good or bad) you have will go to all summons.

Put on an Old Nothren Crown and Arisen Arch-gadget to block the bad debuffs. Use Deific Channel, then Realmshift, and then Rhada Pact. All your summons get DC and some combination of all the good stuff Realmshift can do. An Anubis and 4 Greater Hydras can rip 150-200k per turn. If you have some spare time before all the buffs run off your summons, you can drop an Ultima which will likely hit for weakness damage on almost everything thanks to the Sigils it will put on everything.

It's much easier on the consumables and is easier to play than with bloodpact/lifepact because it's much easier managing the health and mana of everything when you're not dealing with HP drain on yourself from berserk, HP drain on summons from blood pact, restoring HP to summons at the cost of your own HP (which is complicated from the berserk drain), etc, etc

body:
Get book and staff from arisen charon. Gear from raid. Use grand summon abillity for strong summons, and buff them(Rhada pact) with deific Chanel. Use ward skills And def buffs. Have Maji as specialization.

Or

You can wield 2 staffs with good mag, go sequencer specialization, then summon your current highest HP summons, deific Chanel and blood pact. Use ward and def buffs ofcourse.
